name: trigger_search
description: The single trigger tool: searches ALL available event trigger types (library + project, by embedding) AND manages trigger instances (create, list, get, update, delete). Use action=search first to find a valid trigger type, then action=create with that trigger_name plus task and config to arm a one-time reactive skill. Use list/get/update/delete to manage armed triggers.

action.description: search: find trigger types by capability. create/list/get/update/delete: manage armed triggers.

query.description: Capability or trigger you need, e.g. new file, new message. Required for search.

top_k.description: How many closest triggers to return. Default 3, raise when you need broader options.

trigger_name.description: Trigger type name from a search result, e.g. filesystem_new_file. Required for create.

task.description: Task to run once when triggered (turned into a Skill). Required for create.

config.description: JSON object with trigger-specific config, e.g. {"watch_path": "inbox/docs"}.

trigger_id.description: Armed trigger ID. Required for get/update/delete.
